name: Aether SD-Core (OMEC Project)
what_it_is: Open-source 5G standalone core network from the Open Networking Foundation (ONF) / Linux Foundation Aether platform, providing both control plane (AMF, SMF, NRF, PCF, AUSF, UDM, UDR, NSSF) and user plane (UPF) functions. Deployed via Kubernetes Helm charts and integrated with the Aether-OnRamp framework for end-to-end 5G packet forwarding.
protocols: NGAP (Next Generation Application Protocol, over SCTP)
GTP-U (GPRS Tunnelling Protocol - User plane, N3 interface)
SBI (Service-Based Interface, HTTP/2 REST between NFs)
SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol, N2 interface port 38412)
measurement: No built-in measurement or observability stack documented in the Helm charts repository
Prometheus/Grafana integration not confirmed in available documentation
configuration: External IP addresses for N2, N3, N6 network interfaces
Host routing and subnet definitions per interface
Network slice provisioning settings (SST, SD values)
DPDK and hugepage enablement for high-performance UPF
Static IP address management for UE pools
values.yaml overrides required for functional pod instantiation
macvlan or alternative CNI plugins for data-plane networking
modes: 5G Standalone (SA) core — only SA mode supported; NSA (Non-Standalone) not provided
Kubernetes deployment via Helm charts (production/integration mode)
Aether-OnRamp managed deployment (guided on-ramp for edge/enterprise sites)
constraints: Requires Kubernetes cluster with appropriate CNI support (macvlan or similar) — bare-metal or VM with SR-IOV/DPDK for UPF
Default values.yaml files do not produce a functional deployment without operator-supplied IP/interface overrides
No fault injection or chaos-engineering tooling included in the project
No docker-compose file present; deployment is Kubernetes-only via Helm
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos engineering support
No built-in observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana) in the Helm chart repository
No RAN simulator bundled — requires external gNB simulator (e.g., gNBSim, UERANSIM)
